title: Neural-network-assisted MIP for the Unit Commitment problem: models, code and results
description:
GAMS models, MATLAB pipeline, trained neural networks, calibrated fixing bands and campaign results of the four test cases of the Gran Canaria power system (thermal and hydrothermal, base and extended formulation) used in the accompanying paper.

The repository reproduces every table and figure of the paper from the stored results, without solving a single MILP, through reproduce/reproduce_all.m.

The demand and wind series in data/ come from Red Eléctrica de España and keep their own terms of use; the parameters of the Gran Canaria system are those published in the accompanying paper and in the reference it takes them from.
